review_only.label: Review Only
review_only.description: Candidate-review mode for daily shot selection. No parameter fitting is allowed.

include: Daily candidate-review batches from current 100-image shortlist runs
Mixed front / three_quarter / side candidate observations used for human review only
exclude: Do not use this preset for parameter fitting
Do not relabel candidate-review sets as benchmark_frozen

front_core_fit.label: Front Core Fit
front_core_fit.description: Fit only the front mainline once front anchors and front benchmark labels are frozen.

include: Frozen front-only benchmark images with full-body framing
Known front false-warn and false-pass regressions
Front images that match the target production composition
exclude: Cropped headshots or partial-body images that cannot represent front full-body release decisions

three_quarter_fit.label: Three-Quarter Fit
three_quarter_fit.description: Fit the three-quarter review lane after three-quarter anchors are frozen.

include: Frozen three-quarter benchmark images with stable upper/full-body evidence
Three-quarter images that frequently trigger soft-review reasons
Three-quarter regression cases validated by human arbitration
exclude: Pure front images mixed into the same fit study
Loose candidate-review images without final human sealing

side90_shadow_fit.label: Side-90 Shadow Fit
side90_shadow_fit.description: Fit the side_90 shadow lane after profile-like face anchors and side full-body anchors are frozen.

include: Frozen side_90 full-body benchmark images with feet in frame
Profile-like identity checks paired with side body geometry checks
Side shadow regressions that were manually confirmed
exclude: Head-and-shoulder side crops without usable upper/full-body evidence
Front and three-quarter release images mixed into the same study

back180_shadow_fit.label: Back-180 Shadow Fit
back180_shadow_fit.description: Fit the back_180 shadow lane after back full-body anchors and back upper supports are frozen.

include: Frozen back_180 full-body benchmark images with complete body contour and feet in frame
Back-view upper/full-body regressions validated by human arbitration
Back images that match the target production framing and posture
exclude: Front, three_quarter, or side_90 images mixed into the same study
Back crops that lose lower body geometry or feet evidence

full_release_fit.label: Full Release Fit
full_release_fit.description: Full-release fit after front, three-quarter, side, and back anchor lanes are all frozen.

include: Frozen cross-lane benchmark set covering front, three_quarter, side_90, and back_180
Balanced examples per lane and per task profile
exclude: Overrepresentation of one lane such as front-only batches
